propositions: macOS N=3000 import benchmark creates 13.69s system CPU cost across 24 git-add/git-commit pairs during pytest basetemp tree population, consuming thousands of temporary Git stores.

Measured local full-suite default tier retained 1.138 GiB across 233910 files and integration tier retained 1.139 GiB across 25863 files, requiring 2.171 GiB total if both trees coexist, exceeding proposed 1-2 GiB RAM disk sizing with insufficient 50% headroom.

RAM-disk treatment runs (31869753711, 31869919362, 31870391571, 31873067707) executed the same 13397/65-skipped default suite in 18m43s, 20m54s, 18m26s, and 20m00s respectively, all slower than the exact no-RAM control run 31868300174 at 17m26s, failing the predeclared retention threshold of 5% improvement or observed recent-green range.

Intentionally owner-nonwritable workflow snapshot fixture directories (tests/unit/workflow snapshots) caused recursive basetemp cleanup to raise PermissionError during release phase, requiring pre-cleanup chmod restoration before rm -rf.

Nested pytest subprocess in held-out cleanup oracle inherited outer pytest cacheprovider setting, creating leaked .pytest_cache entries that caused test collection divergence unless nested process was explicitly passed -p no:cacheprovider flag.
